DIRECTIONS: Select the correct meanings of the given idioms and phrases out of the given options.

Break a leg:
solution:
The correct answer is **"good luck"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, the most appropriate answer is **'good luck.'**
 
• **Break a leg: **Used instead of good luck.
 
 
• **Example:** *The teacher asked us to break a leg at the annual day dance.*
 
 
 
• ​ Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.​
